capabilities.name: Write functional specifications, BRD or FRD

capabilities.pattern: gap analys|gaps between|current.state and future.state|as.is and to.be|future.state|current.state|target operating model|operating model

capabilities.name: Build a business case
capabilities.note: kept: highly demonstrable, your pricing project is one

capabilities.name: Define data dictionaries and definitions
capabilities.pattern: data dictionar|data definition|single source of truth
capabilities.note: kept; 'metric definition' moved to the KPI row

capabilities.name: Map processes and build flow diagrams
Identify and deliver process improvements
capabilities.note: pattern tightened: dropped 'efficienc', which hit 77 postings on company goals rather than asks

capabilities.name: Prioritize a backlog or competing requests
capabilities.note: pattern rewritten twice. The bare verb gave 79 (inflated by soft-skill mentions). My first tightening gave 22 (it rejected 'prioritize product backlog items', which is exactly the ask). This version requires the verb near something being prioritized, scoped to requirement bullets, and gives 57. Honest range is 57 to 71 depending on whether generic 'prioritization skills' counts. Treat as approximate.

capabilities.name: Act as product owner for a delivery team
Validate data quality

capabilities.name: Query data with SQL
capabilities.note: pattern tightened to the clean token; 70 of the original 72 came from it anyway

capabilities.name: Clean and prepare messy data
capabilities.note: kept: low count, high portfolio value

capabilities.name: Build dashboards
capabilities.note: split back out: an interactive dashboard and a static chart are different artifacts, and your own portfolio holds both (Power BI wait times vs the EPCOT rankings)

capabilities.name: Build and maintain recurring reports

capabilities.name: Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions

capabilities.name: Measure experiments and A/B tests

capabilities.name: Manage stakeholders and their expectations
capabilities.note: pattern rebuilt: dropped 'cross.functional', which drove 82 of the old 95 and is boilerplate

capabilities.name: Communicate to technical and non-technical audiences
Produce project documentation and decision logs

capabilities.name: Produce training materials and train users
Drive change management and user adoption
Use AI tools in the analysis workflow
capabilities.note: pattern tightened and scoped to bullets: excludes company branding and the disclosure that THEY screen applicants with AI

removed.name: Work within an SDLC
removed.reason: CUT. Everybody works within an SDLC. There is no project that demonstrates it, so it cannot discriminate between candidates.

removed.name: Work in a regulated environment
removed.reason: CUT as a capability, MOVED to the domain dimension. It is context, not a skill.

removed.name: Configure an ERP or CRM
removed.reason: CUT as a capability, MOVED to the tools dimension. No solo portfolio project configures an ERP, and the app exists to recommend projects a person can actually build.

demonstrableLegend.solo: One person with public data and tools. A portfolio project can evidence this.
demonstrableLegend.outreach: Needs other people, but reachable without a job: open source maintainers, a volunteer organization, user interviews.
demonstrableLegend.employment: Needs a real organization with real stakes. No portfolio project can honestly evidence this, and the tool should say so rather than invent one.
